blocks.text: Today's AI tools don't only understand text – they can "see" pictures. You take a photo and the AI explains what's in it.

items: Photograph instructions in a foreign language and ask for a translation.
Snap a receipt and ask it to put the items in a table.
Photograph a plant or a fault and ask what it is (then check!).
Send a chart and ask for an explanation.

blocks.text: [attach a photo of a receipt] Put all the items from this receipt in a table: name, quantity, price. At the end, add up the total and compare it with the amount on the receipt.
Some AI tools can also create a new image from your description. Describe what's in the picture, the style, colours and layout. The more precise the description, the better the image.
Claude reads and analyses the images and documents you send it very well, but it doesn't create new images – use another tool for that.
Make an illustration for a birthday invitation: a cheerful bear with balloons, pastel colours, simple cartoon style, empty space at the top for text.

Don't send photos of other people's faces or documents without permission. And don't present AI-made images as real photos.
ChatGPT can both analyse images and create new ones from your description.
Gemini can both analyse images and create new ones from your description.
